Messages.Author: Marko Saari
Messages.Body:
Some questions to keep LSJ busy :)

1. Drawing out the Beast & Terror Frenzy

What if I play Drawing out the Beast and Terror Frenzy (inferior) in the
same
combat? Can the opposing minion use maneuvers & presses at all?

2. Cailean and Immortal Grapple.

In first round of combat Cailean sets the combat range
close. Anvil plays immortal grapple and use it's press to go second round.
Can Cailean use his ability in the second round to set range to long or is
the combat at close range (because of Immortal Grapple)?

3. Bleeding & Archon Investigation

Minion is bleeding me with +3 bleed. I don't block it but I play telepathic
counter and reduce bleed by 2. Next card I draw is Archon Investigation. Can
I burn
the bleeding minion or is it played like it's bleeding only 2 (because I
used Telepathic Counter)?

Thanks!

- Guzmo

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Marko Saari wrote:
>
> Some questions to keep LSJ busy :)
>
> 1. Drawing out the Beast & Terror Frenzy
>
> What if I play Drawing out the Beast and Terror Frenzy (inferior) in the
> same
> combat? Can the opposing minion use maneuvers & presses at all?

No. (card text).

> 2. Cailean and Immortal Grapple.
>
> In first round of combat Cailean sets the combat range
> close. Anvil plays immortal grapple and use it's press to go second round.
> Can Cailean use his ability in the second round to set range to long or is
> the combat at close range (because of Immortal Grapple)?

No. Card text. The first effect to set range has precedence. Once range is
set, it cannot be reset.

> 3. Bleeding & Archon Investigation
>
> Minion is bleeding me with +3 bleed. I don't block it but I play telepathic
> counter and reduce bleed by 2. Next card I draw is Archon Investigation. Can
> I burn
> the bleeding minion or is it played like it's bleeding only 2 (because I
> used Telepathic Counter)?

No. The bleed must be for more than 3 (card text).
